<table style="width: 100%;"><tr><td>flag_trait_outliers</td><td style="text-align: right;">R Documentation</td></tr></table>

<h2>Flag Trait Outliers Within Groups</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Adds 'n_group_records' and 'is_trait_outlier' columns to grouped
trait records using a symmetric median-IQR fence. The caller is
responsible for grouping 'data_trait_records' with
'dplyr::group_by()' before calling this function. The returned data
frame is always ungrouped.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>flag_trait_outliers(
  data_trait_records,
  trait_value_column = "trait_value",
  iqr_multiplier,
  minimum_group_size = NULL
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="data_trait_records">data_trait_records</code></td>
<td>
<p>A grouped data frame (e.g. created by 'dplyr::group_by()').
Must contain the column named by 'trait_value_column'.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="trait_value_column">trait_value_column</code></td>
<td>
<p>Character scalar. Name of the numeric column to test.
Default: '&quot;trait_value&quot;'.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="iqr_multiplier">iqr_multiplier</code></td>
<td>
<p>Positive numeric scalar. IQR fence multiplier. A value is
flagged when
'|value - group_median| &gt; iqr_multiplier * group_IQR'.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="minimum_group_size">minimum_group_size</code></td>
<td>
<p>Optional positive integer scalar. When supplied,
'is_trait_outlier' is set to 'FALSE' for groups with fewer than
'minimum_group_size' records or with an IQR of zero. Default:
'NULL' (no group-size guard applied).</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Details</h3>

<p>The IQR fence is
'[group_median - iqr_multiplier * group_IQR,
group_median + iqr_multiplier * group_IQR]'.
Values outside this range receive 'is_trait_outlier = TRUE'.
</p>
<p>When 'minimum_group_size' is not 'NULL', an additional guard is
applied: groups with fewer than 'minimum_group_size' records or a
'group_IQR' of zero always receive 'is_trait_outlier = FALSE'.
</p>
<p>Designed for use in pipes where the caller sets up grouping:
&ldquo;'r
data_traits |&gt;
dplyr::group_by(trait_domain_name) |&gt;
flag_trait_outliers(iqr_multiplier = 3)
&ldquo;'
</p>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>An ungrouped data frame with the same rows and columns as
'data_trait_records' plus two additional columns:
</p>

<dl>
<dt>'n_group_records'</dt><dd><p>Integer. Number of records in the group.</p>
</dd>
<dt>'is_trait_outlier'</dt><dd><p>Logical. &lsquo;TRUE' when the record&rsquo;s
value falls outside the IQR fence; 'FALSE' otherwise.
When 'minimum_group_size' is supplied, also 'FALSE' for groups
that are too small or have zero IQR.</p>
</dd>
</dl>



<h3>See Also</h3>

<p>[filter_trait_outliers()], [generate_trait_qc_report()]
</p>

</main>
